name: Crystal Clash
author: Unity Play
description:
Crystal Clash is an exciting, jewel-filled Match 3 puzzle adventure! Dive into a vibrant world of shimmering crystals, where your goal is to match and crush sparkling gems to clear levels and unlock new challenges. With hundreds of unique levels, power-ups, and boosters at your disposal, you’ll experience thrilling puzzles that get more challenging as you progress. Compete with friends, overcome tricky obstacles, and unleash powerful combos in this dazzling journey. Can you conquer the crystals and become the ultimate clash master?


If you found a Bug in the Game please report it on our official X Handle @STXHearts
